description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the LimitOption interface, representing a limit configuration with offset and count for a search query or similar operation.

classes.name: ImmutableLimitOption
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the LimitOption interface, encapsulating a limit with offset and count, and providing factory method and standard overrides.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ImmutableLimitOption with specified offset and count.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts an OptionVisitor to perform operations on this LimitOption instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ImmutableLimitOption instances based on offset and count.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on offset and count.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the limit in the form 'limit(offset,count)'.
